subject: Choice of estimator with multiple groups (some more skewed than others)

messages.subject: Choice of estimator with multiple groups (some more skewed than others)
parts:
Hi,

this is my first post in this group, I hope I am doing this correctly.

Let me sketch my problem: 
I have four groups that completed a personality test (25 scales) in different conditions. Two conditions were 'faking' conditions, this means that the distributions in these groups are more skewed than in the other two. I converted all the scores into Zscores so I essentially have continuous data. The marda test showed multivariate skewness. Now I want to test invariance of a five factor model over the four groups.

I am getting kind of lost in the information on which estimator to use. Which would be the best in this case?

I tried some different estimators and for the configural model and fit indices were dramatically different (CFI of .90 for DWLS to .35 in WLS).

Thank you!

Best, Dirk
